mapper.select: select /* raw */ now()with active_users as (select u.id, u.name, row_number() over (partition by u.org_id order by u.created_at desc) rn from users u where u.deleted = false) select au.id, au.name, coalesce(p.display_name, au.name) display_name, case when exists (select 1 from orders o where o.user_id = au.id) then 'ACTIVE' else 'NEW' end status from active_users au left join profiles p on p.user_id = au.id where au.rn = 1and status = #{status}and au.id in (select ut.user_id from user_tags ut where ut.tag in#{tag})order by au.name asc
